# RegexMatch

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

An immutable snapshot of one regular-expression match and its capture groups.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#regular-expressions).

## Group

```PPL
RegexMatch.Group(INTEGER index) STRING
```

Instance function.

Returns a numbered capture. Group zero is the complete match.

## GroupCount

`RegexMatch.GroupCount: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

The number of capture groups, excluding group zero for the complete match.

## GroupLength

```PPL
RegexMatch.GroupLength(INTEGER index) INTEGER
```

Instance function.

Returns the selected capture's length in Unicode code points (scalar values).

## GroupMatched

```PPL
RegexMatch.GroupMatched(INTEGER index) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Reports whether the selected optional capture participated in the match.

## GroupStart

```PPL
RegexMatch.GroupStart(INTEGER index) INTEGER
```

Instance function.

Returns the selected capture's zero-based Unicode code point position, or -1 when it did not participate.

## Length

`RegexMatch.Length: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

The match length in Unicode code points (scalar values), not bytes or graphemes.

## NamedGroup

```PPL
RegexMatch.NamedGroup(STRING name) STRING
```

Instance function.

Returns a named capture.

## NamedGroupLength

```PPL
RegexMatch.NamedGroupLength(STRING name) INTEGER
```

Instance function.

Returns the selected capture's length in Unicode code points (scalar values).

## NamedGroupMatched

```PPL
RegexMatch.NamedGroupMatched(STRING name) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Reports whether the selected optional capture participated in the match.

## NamedGroupStart

```PPL
RegexMatch.NamedGroupStart(STRING name) INTEGER
```

Instance function.

Returns the selected capture's zero-based Unicode code point position, or -1 when it did not participate.

## Start

`RegexMatch.Start: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

The zero-based Unicode code point position of the match, or -1 when no match was found.

## Success

`RegexMatch.Success: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether a match was found.

## Value

`RegexMatch.Value: STRING`

Read-only instance property.

The complete matched text.
